world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Touguele, Samuel, Phonologie et Morphologie de la langue ngbugu parlee dans la Basse-Kotto en Centrafrique; also Galla Althabegoity, Elements de phonologie du ngbugu

sources.citation: Vancaeyzeele, Charles & Galla Althabégoïty. 2025. Rounding contrast activation in Ngbúgù: licensing and sub-segmental interactions. (HAL hal-04962481v2, 57 pp.)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing about Ngbugu stress; fn. 3 notes three-tone system; one theoretical footnote mentions stress only generically (foot heads) and calls it irrelevant because the data are monosyllabic morphemes.

sources.citation: Althabégoïty, Galla. 2024. Étude des verbes en ngbugu, langue du groupe banda (oubanguien, Niger-Congo) de Centrafrique. Thèse de doctorat, Université Lumière Lyon 2. 479 pp. (HAL tel-05023143). Ch. 2 'Description phonologique du ngbugu', pp. 41-86.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing: full phonology chapter (tone system p.43, syllable types, 33 consonants, 9-10 vowels, phrase-final vowel loss, contour tones in discourse) never mentions accent/stress; states Ngbugu is a tone language with three level tones, no vowel-length contrast, verbs toneless lexically.

sources.citation: Olson, Kenneth S. 2022. On the Ngbugu vowel system. In G. Sibanda, D. Ngonyani, J. Choti & A. Biersteker (eds.), Descriptive and theoretical approaches to African linguistics (Selected papers from ACAL 49), 9-23. Berlin: Language Science Press. doi:10.5281/zenodo.6393734
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; oral vowel inventory and acoustics only (tone transcribed, no prosody discussion). Useful for its summary of Théret-Kieschke 1998 and Cloarec-Heiss 1978 vowel charts.

sources.citation: Olson, Kenneth S. & Jacques Vermond Mbomate. 2007. Ngbugu digital wordlist: presentation form. Linguistic Discovery 5(1): 40-47. doi:10.1349/PS1.1537-0852.A.317
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; 204-item wordlist with tone-marked broad phonetic transcriptions, no prosodic commentary.
